about: The mutant ledger of internal/testinputs: edits of the observer that its tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/testinputs; the package's own tests run unobserved, so the sweep gives them no identity. Seeded by wf10 fu-sweep-mounts.

mutants.name: mount-change-ignored
mutants.rule: A mount made during the run over a directory a lookup passed leaves the run's inputs unknown.

mutants.name: mount-verdict-any-point
mutants.rule: A mount no lookup of the run passed (another lane's Rift) is no reason.

mutants.name: mount-verdict-no-point
mutants.rule: A changed mount a lookup passed is a reason.

mutants.name: mount-undone-accepted
mutants.from: return prefix + ", and changed back, so where is unknown"
mutants.rule: A change made and undone during the run, whose place is unknown, is a reason.

mutants.name: mount-lookup-name-ignored
mutants.rule: A mount at a name a lookup used is a reason, though the run never looked inside it.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-record-unobserved
mutants.rule: A recorded run gives itself a test log, so it is observed as a swept run is.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-record-no-identity
mutants.from: if err := os.Setenv(IdentityVariable, filepath.Join(dir, RecordIdentity)); err != nil {
mutants.to: if err := os.Setenv(IdentityVariable+"_NOT", filepath.Join(dir, RecordIdentity)); err != nil {
mutants.rule: A recorded run writes the observer's access-time identity, which the sweep's classification of its log needs.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-record-tree-unprobed
mutants.rule: A recorded run measures whether it saw the checkout read-only; it never assumes it.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-record-userns-assumed
mutants.rule: A recorded run asks the kernel whether it can make a user namespace; it never assumes it cannot.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-record-inherited
mutants.rule: Only the recording process records: the tests, and a test binary they start again, do not see the record's variable.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-namespaces-recorded
mutants.rule: A package whose tests make user namespaces does not record its run in the sweep's view, where those tests would fail or skip.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-namespaces-undeclared
mutants.rule: An observed package whose tests make user namespaces says so in its TestMain.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-record-unboxed
mutants.rule: A recorded run without the sweep's view executes itself again in bwrap, so a go test step's run can stand for a swept one.
